Dear The Synergist Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position. With a background in digital marketing, web design, and project coordination, I am excited about the opportunity to support your mission of tackling global societal challenges through effective communication.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage multi-channel campaigns, coordinate content production, and maintain client websites. I am proficient in tools like WordPress, Canva, and Google Workspace, and I have experience with project tracking and vendor follow-ups. My proactive approach ensures deadlines are met and projects stay on track.

I am particularly drawn to The Synergist's collaborative and purpose-driven environment. I am eager to bring my organizational skills and tech-savviness to support your campaigns and events, and to grow within a team that values innovation and impact.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position at The Synergist. Your mission to address complex global issues like health equity and rare diseases through collective action resonates deeply with me. I am eager to contribute my organizational skills, technical agility, and passion for meaningful work to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed the skills necessary to be the operational engine you are looking for. I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and ensure projects are delivered on time. My experience with WordPress, Canva, and Google Workspace aligns with your needs for asset management and routine updates. I am also proficient in Asana and have used it to track tasks and deadlines, ensuring smooth workflow.

I possess a proactive 'chaser' mindset, comfortable in following up with vendors and internal teams to keep projects moving. My background in front-end development gives me a technical edge, allowing me to quickly adapt to tools like Figma and HubSpot. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, which I am actively improving.

What draws me to The Synergist is the opportunity to use communications for high-impact societal change. I am inspired by your role as an incubator for collaboration and innovation. I am confident that my organizational mastery, attention to detail, and ability to manage overlapping timelines will make me a valuable asset to your team.

I would love to bring my energy and operational skills to support your campaigns and events. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your impactful work.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · Communications · Project Coordination · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Project Coordination: Asana, deadline tracking, vendor follow-ups, event logistics
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building, Canva, Figma
- Social Media: content creation, community management, LinkedIn
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
